newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sino Land says flat sales seen in March.
newsitem.headline: Sino Land says flat sales seen in March.

text.p: Sino Land Co Ltd's Waterside residential development in Ma On Shan in Hong Kong's New Territories is expected to go on sale in March, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.
"The sale is possibly in March, but the final timeframe has to be confirmed," he told Reuters.
The Waterside has a total of 502 units and construction is expected to be completed in April.
Sino Land has recently completed a luxury residential development in Kau To Shan, Shatin, the spokesman said.
The development, Windsor Height with 40 houses of more than 2,000 sq ft each, is expected to be sold above HK$10,000/sq ft.
The company is still studying a marketing strategy for the development and no sales schedule has been fixed yet, the spokesman said.
